comments.author: Aguirre
comments.body: Plundered this today. Sailed around the three islands south of Sicily attacking all Malta Pirate fleets. The fleet appeared after about one hour. Per Guilder's note, watch for a fleet of 4 of which two have black sails with the unicorn crest.
